Overview

Ventspils is a city in Ventspils with a population of 34,377. Latvia’s most important ice-free port, a well-planned city with a beautiful blue flag beach, the Ventspils Castle of the Livonian Order, and a high quality of life. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
